purpose: One issue on a board: its key, linked pull request, assignee, title, priority, tags, comments and due date, as a single link people can also drag between lanes.

Default.visual: Surface/layer-2 with a Border/default stroke (Stroke/divider); key, pull request, comments and due in Content/secondary (Type/caption); title in Content/primary (Type/label).

Hover.visual: The stroke moves to Border/strong on use-hover.

Dragging.meaning: The person drags the card; the app sets forceState Dragging.
Dragging.visual: The stroke turns Border/accent; the position follows the pointer with no transition.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter follows the link.
a11y.reducedMotion: The edge and shadow ease on use-hover, which keeps its duration under reduced motion (lib/motion.ts); while dragged the position follows the pointer with no transition.
notes: Focus-visible draws Border/focus with the Border/ring/default ring; the Figma set has no Focused variant.

openQuestions: Built Figma-first under exception STG-001 (governance/exceptions.yaml, review by 2026-12-02): the stories still need the owner's approval. Is the Figma set final for this intent?
Keyboard: how does a keyboard user move a card to another lane?
Every state binds shadow None, yet the motion eases box-shadow. Should Dragging lift the card with a shadow?
